primary_users: developers and technical users operating local AI models
engineers evaluating runtime capability resource behavior and model configurations
primary_jobs: understand whether the local AI runtime is ready and what is resident or available
configure and execute inference without needing to reason about unnecessary internal plumbing
inspect evaluation evidence and resource/runtime state truthfully
recover safely from unsupported configurations runtime failures and resource pressure
primary_surfaces: Local LLM Studio browser control plane

accessibility.target: WCAG 2.2 AA for the browser control-plane surface

design_system.component_source: src/local_llm_server/static/design-system.css with source-backed renderers under src/local_llm_server/static/control-plane-*.js and components.js

critical_journeys.name: Open the control plane, understand truthful server/runtime status and navigate between core surfaces
Configure a model request, submit inference, observe progress or failure and recover for the next request
Understand model availability and residency and perform an intentional runtime-management action
Start or review evaluation state and inspect comparable result/history evidence without confusing unavailable data with zero
Complete a product run and leave no project-owned listener process temporary state or unbounded diagnostic residue

reference_views: implemented control-plane shell and overview sources under src/local_llm_server/static/control-plane-*
implemented Local LLM Studio chat/configuration surface in src/local_llm_server/static/index.html
critical loading/empty/error/status source states covered by tests/e2e and tests/test_accessibility_ui_assets.py

validation.accessibility_automation: pytest -q tests/test_accessibility_ui_assets.py plus Playwright critical-journey assertions
validation.visual_regression: n/a for current unstable/incidental pixels; semantic visual contracts and design-system drift are blocking, pixel baselines are added only for stable high-risk surfaces
